about_the_game:
Is math fun? Welcome to the world of Margin of Error, a roguelike deck-builder with a unique mathematical puzzle twist, inspired by the thrill of Balatro! Prepare your strategy, because here, numbers and your logic are your primary weapons for survival.

Core Gameplay: Numerical Strategy and Destructive Power In Margin Error, every battle is a dynamic mathematical challenge. You'll face off against various ferocious fantasy races, and your mission is to unleash as much damage as possible. Utilize cards featuring numbers 0-9 and unique operators like +, -, x, pi, and more, to chain together deadly combinations.

Progression & Upgrade System: Stamps, Batches, and Gacha Significantly boost your attack power with an innovative buff system: Stamps and Batches. Stamps offer permanent statistical enhancements, while Batches provide situational buffs that can turn the tide of battle. Visit the shop to engage in a thrilling gacha system, where you can acquire rare Stamps and Batches to perfect your build. Every gacha pull can bring you one step closer to dominance or test your luck.

Face Unexpected Challenges: Varied Enemy Debuffs However, the path to victory is not easy. Every fantasy race you encounter possesses a unique set of debuffs that will push the limits of your strategy. Whether it's reducing your damage, altering card values, or limiting your moves, you must adapt and find ways to overcome these obstacles. One wrong move can ruin everything, or turn you into a legend of numbers! Let's learn while playing!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 (2.0 GHz) or AMD FX-4100 (2.0 GHz)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 compatible graphics card with 512 MB VRAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10+ (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 (3.2 GHz) or AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (3.1 GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card with 1 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

short_description: Margin of Error is a Balatro-inspired roguelike deck-building game with a mathematical puzzle twist, where you play not just with numbers - but also with logic and strategy. it features a card system with numbers 0-9 and unique operators like +, -, ×, (pi), etc.
